from more_itertools import (
    sliced, split_at, split_before, split_after, split_when,
    stagger, zip_equal, UnequalIterablesError
)

# R1: maxsplit on sliced
assert list(sliced('ABCDEF', 2)) == ['AB', 'CD', 'EF']
assert list(sliced('ABCDEF', 2, maxsplit=1)) == ['AB']
assert list(sliced('ABCDEF', 2, maxsplit=0)) == []
assert list(sliced('ABCDEF', 2, maxsplit=9)) == ['AB', 'CD', 'EF']

# R1: maxsplit on split_after
assert list(split_after('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.')) == [['A', '.'], ['B', '.'], ['C']]
assert list(split_after('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1)) == [['A', '.'], ['B', '.', 'C']]
assert list(split_after('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=0)) == [['A', '.', 'B', '.', 'C']]

# R1: maxsplit on split_before
assert list(split_before('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.')) == [['A'], ['.', 'B'], ['.', 'C']]
assert list(split_before('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=1)) == [['A'], ['.', 'B', '.', 'C']]
assert list(split_before('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', maxsplit=0)) == [['A', '.', 'B', '.', 'C']]

# R1: maxsplit on split_when
assert list(split_when('ABCD', lambda a, b: a == 'B')) == [['A'], ['C', 'D']]
assert list(split_when('ABCD', lambda a, b: a == 'B', maxsplit=0)) == [['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']]
assert list(split_when('ABCD', lambda a, b: a == 'B', maxsplit=1)) == [['A'], ['C', 'D']]

# R2: keep_separator on split_at
assert list(split_at('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.')) == [['A'], ['B'], ['C']]
assert list(split_at('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', keep_separator=True)) == [['A', '.'], ['B', '.'], ['C']]
assert list(split_at('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', keep_separator=False)) == [['A'], ['B'], ['C']]
assert list(split_at('A.B.C', lambda c: c == '.', keep_separator=True, maxsplit=1)) == [['A', '.'], ['B', '.', 'C']]

# R3: zip_equal
assert list(zip_equal([1,2], 'ab')) == [(1,'a'),(2,'b')]
assert list(zip_equal([], '')) == []
try:
    list(zip_equal([1,2,3], 'ab'))
    assert False, 'should raise'
except UnequalIterablesError:
    pass
try:    
    list(zip_equal([1,2], 'abc'))
    assert False, 'should raise'
except UnequalIterablesError:
    pass

# R4: stagger (basic)
assert list(stagger([1,2,3])) == [(None,1,2), (1,2,3)]

print('=== ALL COMPREHENSIVE TESTS PASSED ===')
